Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.engine

Class GameSession

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.engine.GameSession
public class GameSession extends Object
The central object of a run: owns the floors, the player, the turn scheduler and the message log, and is the only entry point for player actions.

Typical use: 


 GameSession game = GameFactory.newGame(42L, "Ada", Difficulty.UNDERGRADUATE);
 game.submit(new MoveCommand(Direction.EAST));
 System.out.println(game.render());

The session has no dependency on any user-interface library. Everything it does is driven by submit(Command), so the same seed and commands reproduce a run.

    • submit

      public CommandResult submit(Command command)
      Executes one player command. If the command used time, every other actor then takes its turns until the player is next, and visibility is recalculated.
      Parameters:
      command - the action to attempt
      Returns:
      the command's result; a rejected result means no time passed
